topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I found my partner’s bucket list tucked away in an old drawer. It’s a simple piece of paper, but it’s full of dreams and aspirations that I hadn’t known about. Seeing it makes me want to help them achieve every single goal. I’m thinking about planning a surprise to start ticking some of these off. Maybe we can start with that trip to the coast they’ve always wanted to take. It’s a small thing, but it’s a way to show that I’m here for their dreams, not just the day-to-day.
